title: Shantell Sans (2023)
summary: Shantell Sans is a custom typeface designed by artist Shantell Martin, released in 2023 as an open-source font for the creative community. The project documents the design process behind creating this distinctive, hand-drawn style typeface that balances artistic expression with practical usability.
problem_solved: Makes unique artistic typography accessible to designers and developers who previously couldn't afford custom font commissions.
why_valuable: It provides a free, high-quality artistic typeface that brings hand-drawn expression to digital projects while supporting the open-source creative community.
